mapper.select: SELECT "l"."rosen_id" , "l"."rosen_name" , "lc"."line_charge_id" , "lc"."payment_method" , "lc"."line_charge_division" , "lc"."uniform_charge" , "lc"."uniform_ic_price" , "lc"."uniform_transfer_type" , "lbs_board"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "rosen_bus_stop_id_from" , "lbs_alight"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AS "rosen_bus_stop_id_to" , "bs_board"."bus_stop_name" AS "rosen_bus_stop_name_from" , "bs_alight"."bus_stop_name" AS "rosen_bus_stop_name_to" , "lcd"."line_charge_detail_id" , "lcd"."line_charge" , "lcd"."ic_price" , "cr"."charge_revision_id" , "cr"."service_start_date" , "cr"."service_end_date" , "cr"."revision_reason" FROM "charge_revisions" "cr" JOIN "lines" "l" ON "l"."del_flag" = 0 AND "l"."available_flag" = 1 AND "l"."rosen_id" = "cr"."rosen_id" JOIN "agencies" "a" ON "a"."del_flag" = 0 AND "a"."available_flag" = 1 AND "a"."business_corp_id" = "l"."business_corp_id" JOIN "line_bus_stops" "lbs_board" ON "lbs_board"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs_board"."ride_alight_division" != 1 AND "lbs_board"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" JOIN "line_bus_stops" "lbs_alight" ON "lbs_alight"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lbs_alight"."ride_alight_division" != 0 AND "lbs_alight"."rosen_id" = "l"."rosen_id" AND "lbs_alight"."sequence_no" > "lbs_board"."sequence_no" JOIN "bus_stops" "bs_board" ON "bs_board"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs_board"."available_flag" = 1 AND "bs_board"."bus_stop_id" = "lbs_board"."bus_stop_id" JOIN "bus_stops" "bs_alight" ON "bs_alight"."del_flag" = 0 AND "bs_alight"."available_flag" = 1 AND "bs_alight"."bus_stop_id" = "lbs_alight"."bus_stop_id" LEFT JOIN "line_charges" "lc" ON "lc"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lc"."charge_revision_id" = "cr"."charge_revision_id" LEFT JOIN "line_charge_details" "lcd" ON "lcd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "lcd"."line_charge_id" = "lc"."line_charge_id" AND "lcd"."rosen_bus_stop_id_from" = "lbs_board"."rosen_bus_stop_id" AND "lcd"."rosen_bus_stop_id_to" = "lbs_alight"."rosen_bus_stop_id" WHERE "cr"."del_flag" = 0 AND "cr"."charge_revision_id" = #{chargeRevisionId} ORDER BY "lbs_board"."sequence_no" , "lbs_alight"."sequence_no"
